title: ccp16 generator oracle diverges from implementation on step-4 (consistency vector expects 9, implementation gives 8)
description: Pre-existing discrepancy surfaced while fixing worker6-b7z9.30.1 (density threshold 10->8 in python/src/lichen/ccp.py adaptive_sf_select). The generator _v (test/vectors/generate.py:2342-2377, ccp16_vectors) computes sf from the adaptive_sf TABLE path only, while the implementations run the full pseudocode INCLUDING step-4 (EMA_SNR > 8 AND Density < 5 -> SF-1). For the synchronized_hop_channel_consistency vector (density=3, snr=12): generator says sf=9 (table), implementation says sf=8 (9 then step-4 -1) — verified via PYTHONPATH=python/src probe both before and after the threshold change, so this is NOT caused by b7z9.30.1. Fix: make _v model the full pseudocode (steps 3-5 + post-step-6 floors per spec 2a.8, mirroring ccp.py/gradient.c/rf_health.rs), regenerate ccp16.json, and re-check test_adaptive_sf_select_ccp16 + test_ccp16_vectors_match_generator together. Careful: ccp16-hop.json shares _hop_hash oracle machinery — check whether ccp16-hop vectors also carry sf expectations before regenerating.
close_reason: Re-close (store churn reverted earlier close): full sweep of ALL ccp16.json vector rows against the implementation confirmed zero mismatches. The generator _v oracle matches the implementations at the current tip. The original probe predates the b7z9.30.1 threshold reconciliation. ccp16-hop.json has no sf expectations. No code changes needed.
